technique_name: Describe the cultural implications of a given trend.
description: Food delivery apps are becoming increasingly popular and have had a significant impact on the way people eat and interact. On the one hand, food delivery apps have allowed individuals to conveniently order meals from their homes or workplaces. This has reduced the need for people to dine out, leading to fewer face-to-face interactions within restaurants, cafes, and other social settings.
